audit.method: read again as the act's HTML page on Gesetze im Internet (BJNR….html, the whole act; the check and verify read its xml.zip): the words of the folder against the page's norms (footnotes, the frame norm's citation and Stand box, and an Inhaltsübersicht's body, which the XML holds as a TOC the converter does not write, left out) with the runner's word check (>= 99.5% of written words on the page, >= 97% of the page's words written)

flags.detail: 1 of 5 read again by a second route disagree

gii|germany/bund/acts.note: every act on Gesetze im Internet is held here (bund/gesetze/<act>/, the Grundgesetz in grundgesetz/): an act listed and not held is pending-publish; held acts are compared by their xml.zip's Last-Modified with the read this repository last made of them; first check: every act's xml.zip Last-Modified was recorded as the baseline for the next check

verify.method: a seventh of the held acts each check (and the Grundgesetz): the act's xml.zip re-rendered with the repository's converter (tools/bundesrecht.py act_from_xml) and compared with its folder file for file, byte for byte; the Grundgesetz's articles as tools/grundgesetz.py writes them (article_md of gii_units); acts with a gap this check explains (pending, held back by the builder's checks) counted as explained
